cache_contract: dma_alloc_coherent with DMA API ownership; no extra userspace cache flush/invalidate on these kernel buffers. HP0 is not thereby declared hardware coherent.
ordering: RX issue_pending, TX issue_pending, HLS AP_START; completion callbacks and mutex serialization
board_acceptance_pending: CMA kernel config/location and successful current candidate allocations
Actual PL0 clock provider/rate and reset ownership
Both allocated DMA bus ranges contained entirely in the BD DDR low aperture [0,0x80000000); 32-bit mask alone is not a 2GiB aperture proof
Recompiled current kernel module and new-candidate parity/IRQ evidence
limitations: Coherent allocation need not prove use of CMA without board allocator evidence
User pointer copy path is not mmap/zero-copy; no promise of zero-copy
timeout_ms is waited separately for RX then TX; not a single global wall deadline
DMA terminate_sync stops channels but does not assert HLS ap_rst_n; failed transaction requires controlled full reset recovery
No invalid DMA/fault/reset jobs run on board; driver remove/open-file lifecycle still needs controlled integration review
